about.title: Biometric Profile
about.name: Trần Duy Phát (Dino Péo)
about.bio: I'm a developer specializing in creating modern and optimized web experiences.

1.title: Personal Portfolio
1.description: My personal portfolio website built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Showcasing selected projects, technical skills, and my journey as a frontend developer with a clean, modern, and responsive design.

2.title: E-commerce Website
2.description: A modern e-commerce platform with full cart and payment features. Integrated with React, Tailwind CSS, and Firebase for real-time data management.

3.title: Restaurant Website
3.description: A website for introducing and ordering food at a restaurant, integrating menu management systems, online table booking, and customer feedback (React & Firebase).

4.title: Weather Forecast
4.description: A modern weather forecast application providing real-time information, interactive temperature charts, and detailed forecasts. Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

5.title: Dino Movies
5.description: A simple movie discovery web application built with React and Vite. The app allows users to browse a list of movies and view detailed information for each title, featuring a clean, responsive UI and fast development setup with hot reload.

6.title: DinoStore
6.description: DinoStore is a modern e-commerce web application built with React and Vite, offering an end-to-end online shopping experience. It includes home banners, featured products, detailed product pages, user authentication, cart and wishlist functionality, product filtering, pagination, and a fully responsive UI optimized for all devices.

7.title: DinoBot Discord
7.description: A multi-functional Discord Bot written in Node.js to support automated server management and provide entertaining features for the user community.

8.title: ShopFSTYLE – Fashion E-commerce System
8.description: A full-featured fashion e-commerce website developed as a graduation project. The system includes customer and admin modules, supporting product management with color-size variants, inventory tracking, order processing, user roles, dashboards, and sales statistics. Built with a custom PHP backend, MySQL database, and a responsive frontend focused on real-world business workflows.

9.title: Pokédex Mobile
9.description: A mobile application for exploring the Pokémon world based on the PokéAPI. Built with React Native and TypeScript, featuring an intuitive and vibrant user interface.

10.title: LinkSnap - URL Shortener & Analytics
10.description: An efficient and easy-to-deploy link shortener tool. Supports creating custom short links for more convenient link management.
